mapper.select:
/* BmsEcMapper.selectEcInPlanList : EC송수신조회 - 반입예정 마스터 조회 */
SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT INTERFACE_ID , INTERFACE_SEQ , IS_CUD , PART , IN_NO1 , IN_NO2 , MRN , MSN , HSN , IN_DT , OWNER_CD , OWNER_COMP , ITEM_CD , ITEM_NM1 , MBL_NO , HBL_NO , SHIP_NO , IN_GUBUN , BOND_FM , BOND_TO , SINGO_REQNO , BOND_COMP_CD , PACK_KIND , IN_SAGO_CD , PACK_CNT , OUT_QTY , JEGO_QTY , TOT_WGT , OUT_WGT , JEGO_WGT , TOT_CBM , OUT_CBM1 , OUT_CBM , PLC_LOC , PLC_CONF_DT , PLC_CONF_ID , OVER_YN , OVER_NO , OVER_DT , DATA_CREAT_GBN , WORK_DT , TERM_ID , ELEC_YN , IN_TYPE , CC_SPR_CD , SPC_PKG_GBN , JOUP_DT , IN_PORT_DT , VAL , DUTY , UNLD_PORT_CD , SEND_NAT_CD , SEND_OFFICE , SEND_ADDR1 , SEND_ADDR2 , SEND_ADDR3 , SEND_TEL , RECV_TEL , RECV_NM , RECV_ADDR1 , RECV_ADDR2 , RECV_ADDR3 , RECV_POST_NO , ELEC_DOMAIN , INV_AMT , INV_AMT_UNIT , DIRECT_NO , TRADE_TYPE , USE_GBN , CONTR_NO1 , CONTR_NO2 , FWD_CODE , FWD_FIRM , PASS_REASION , CRIME_SELECTION_YN , TAKBAE_NO , TAKBAE_NM , TAKBAE_LOC , UNI_MATT , HOLD_REASON , RSP_AID , TIMESTAMP , TRNS_ID , SND_SYS_CD , RECV_SYS_CD , DT_PROS_STAT , RECV_YMD , RECV_HMS , DT_REG , CONCAT(MRN, MSN, HSN) AS CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , CONCAT_WS('-', MRN, MSN, HSN) AS CARGO_REFERENCE_NO_DISP
, CASE WHEN PKG_GBN = '10' THEN '10.일반' WHEN PKG_GBN = '11' THEN '11.관리' WHEN PKG_GBN = '12' THEN '12.이사' WHEN PKG_GBN = '14' THEN '14.특송' WHEN PKG_GBN = '15' THEN '15.수출' WHEN PKG_GBN = 'K1016' THEN 'K1016.면세' WHEN PKG_GBN = '17' THEN '17.조달' ELSE PKG_GBN END AS PKG_GBN , CUS_CD1 + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'EDI_CUSTOMS_CODE' AND CODE = CUS_CD1 ) AS CUS_CD1 , CASE WHEN PROS_STAT_CD = 'R' THEN 'R.전송대기' WHEN PROS_STAT_CD = 'P' THEN 'P.작업중' WHEN PROS_STAT_CD = 'D' THEN 'D.작업완료' WHEN PROS_STAT_CD = 'E' THEN 'E.에러' ELSE PROS_STAT_CD END AS PROS_STAT_CD
, PKG_GBN , CUS_CD1 , PROS_STAT_CD
FROM TB_IFR_ECTOG1_IN_PLAN ) A WHERE 1=1

/* BmsEcMapper.selectEcInList : EC송수신조회 - 반입 마스터 조회 */
SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT INTERFACE_ID , INTERFACE_SEQ , IS_CUD , SEQ_NO , PART , IN_NO1 , IN_NO2 , BOND_NO , IN_DT , PLC_LOC , DIVI_IN_YN , MRN , MSN , HSN , MBL , HBL , IN_STD_NO , TANK_NO , IN_QTY , PACK_GBN , IN_WGT , OWNER_CD , SEND_YN , REMARK , TRAN_GBN , BIG_SIZE_YN , INTELLECTUAL_PROP_YN , CHANGE_CLASS , CHANGE_CODE , CHANGE_BEFORE , CHANGE_AFTER , XRAY_MACHINE , TIMESTAMP , TRNS_ID , SND_SYS_CD , RECV_SYS_CD , ERR_MSG , SND_YMD , SND_HMS , DT_REG , CONCAT(MRN, MSN, HSN) AS CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , CONCAT_WS('-', MRN, MSN, HSN) AS CARGO_REFERENCE_NO_DISP
, IN_GUBUN + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'CARRYIN_TYPE' AND CODE = IN_GUBUN ) AS IN_GUBUN , XRAY_GBN + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'INSPECTION TYPE' AND CODE = XRAY_GBN ) AS XRAY_GBN , XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' AND CODE = XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE ) AS XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE , CASE WHEN SND_STAT_CD = 'R' THEN 'R.전송요청/대기' WHEN SND_STAT_CD = 'P' THEN 'P.전송중' WHEN SND_STAT_CD = 'D' THEN 'D.전송완료' WHEN SND_STAT_CD = 'E' THEN 'E.전송에러' ELSE SND_STAT_CD END AS SND_STAT_CD
, IN_GUBUN , XRAY_GBN , XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE , SND_STAT_CD
FROM TB_IFS_G1TOEC_IN )A WHERE 1=1

/* BmsEcMapper.selectEcEtcList : EC송수신조회 - 통관 마스터 조회 */
SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT INTERFACE_ID , INTERFACE_SEQ , IS_CUD , IN_NO1 , IN_NO2 , MRN , MSN , HSN , MBL , HBL , TAKBAE_LBLID , REMARK , TRAN_GBN , XRAY_RESCAN_DATE , LOCATION_SCAN_DATE , LOCATION_PLACE , INSPECTION_YN , INSPECTION_FINISH_DATE , INSPECTION_FINISH_YN , RETURN_DATE , RETURN_REASON , REPAIR_FINISH_DATE , REPAIR_CT , SAMPLE_OUT_CT , SAMPLE_OUT_WT , SAMPLE_IN_CT , SAMPLE_IN_WT , INTELLECTUAL_PROP_YN , INTELLECTUAL_PROP_STAT , PACK_CNT_UNIPASS , TOT_WGT_UNIPASS , OUT_OK_GBN , HOLD_YN , HOLD_REASON , INSPECTION_RESULT_REASON , TIMESTAMP , SND_SYS_CD , RECV_SYS_CD , ERR_MSG , SND_YMD , SND_HMS , DT_REG , CONCAT('-', MRN, MSN, HSN) AS CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , CONCAT_WS('-', MRN, MSN, HSN) AS CARGO_REFERENCE_NO_DISP
, CASE WHEN WORK_GUBUN = '10' THEN '10.판독' WHEN WORK_GUBUN = '11' THEN '11.적치' WHEN WORK_GUBUN = '12' THEN '12.검사' WHEN WORK_GUBUN = '13' THEN '13.재입고' WHEN WORK_GUBUN = '14' THEN '14.보수' WHEN WORK_GUBUN = '15' THEN '15.견품' WHEN WORK_GUBUN = '16' THEN '16.이고' ELSE WORK_GUBUN END AS WORK_GUBUN , XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' AND CODE = XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE ) AS XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE , OUT_OK_TYPE + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'CARRYOUT_TYPE' AND CODE = OUT_OK_TYPE ) AS OUT_OK_TYPE , CASE WHEN SND_STAT_CD = 'R' THEN 'R.전송요청/대기' WHEN SND_STAT_CD = 'P' THEN 'P.전송중' WHEN SND_STAT_CD = 'D' THEN 'D.전송완료' WHEN SND_STAT_CD = 'E' THEN 'E.전송에러' ELSE SND_STAT_CD END AS SND_STAT_CD
, WORK_GUBUN , XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE , OUT_OK_TYPE , SND_STAT_CD
FROM TB_IFS_G1TOEC_ETC )A WHERE 1=1

/* BmsEcMapper.selectEcOutPlanList : EC송수신조회 - 반출승인 마스터 조회 */
SELECT A.* , dbo.Cryptography(A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, A.JUMIN_NO, 1) AS COMPANY_BUSINESS_NO FROM ( SELECT INTERFACE_ID , INTERFACE_SEQ , IS_CUD , SEQ_NO , OUT_OK_NO , OUT_OK_GBN , CUS_SND_DT , OUT_OK_DT , BOND_BUHO , WATCH_YN , MRN , MSN , HSN , DUTY , CIF_COND , VAL , BL_NO , SHIP_NM , IN_PORT_DT , JUMIN_NO , JUMIN_GBN , OFFICE_NM , OWNER_NM , OUT_OK_QTY , OUT_OK_WGT , REMARK , TRAN_GBN , CRITERIA_CODE , INS_PAYMENT_TYPE , INS_PAYMENT_YN , HS_CODE , TIMESTAMP , TRNS_ID , SND_SYS_CD , RECV_SYS_CD , SND_YMD , SND_HMS , DT_REG , CONCAT(MRN, MSN, HSN) AS CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , CONCAT_WS('-', MRN, MSN, HSN) AS CARGO_REFERENCE_NO_DISP
, OUT_OK_TYPE + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'CARRYOUT_TYPE' AND CODE = OUT_OK_TYPE ) AS OUT_OK_TYPE , CASE WHEN SND_STAT_CD = 'R' THEN 'R.전송요청/대기' WHEN SND_STAT_CD = 'P' THEN 'P.전송중' WHEN SND_STAT_CD = 'D' THEN 'D.전송완료' WHEN SND_STAT_CD = 'E' THEN 'E.전송에러' ELSE SND_STAT_CD END AS SND_STAT_CD
, OUT_OK_TYPE , SND_STAT_CD
FROM TB_IFS_G1TOEC_OUT_PLAN )A WHERE 1=1

/* BmsEcMapper.selectEcOutList : EC송수신조회 - 반출 마스터 조회 */
SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT INTERFACE_ID , INTERFACE_SEQ , IS_CUD , SEQ_NO , PART , OUT_NO1 , OUT_NO2 , DIVI_OUT_LAST , BOND_NO , OUT_DT , PLC_LOC , DIVI_OUT_YN , MRN , MSN , HSN , MBL , HBL , OUT_STD_NO , OUT_QTY , PACK_GBN , OUT_WGT , OWNER_CD , SEND_YN , REMARK , TRAN_GBN , OUT_CHUTE_NO , OUT_DATE_TIME , CHANGE_CLASS , CHANGE_CODE , CHANGE_BEFORE , CHANGE_AFTER , TIMESTAMP , TRNS_ID , SND_SYS_CD , RECV_SYS_CD , ERR_MSG , SND_YMD , SND_HMS , DT_REG , CONCAT(MRN, MSN, HSN) AS CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , CONCAT_WS('-', MRN, MSN, HSN) AS CARGO_REFERENCE_NO_DISP
, OUT_GUBUN + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'CARRYOUT_TYPE' AND CODE = OUT_GUBUN ) AS OUT_GUBUN , CASE WHEN SND_STAT_CD = 'R' THEN 'R.전송요청/대기' WHEN SND_STAT_CD = 'P' THEN 'P.전송중' WHEN SND_STAT_CD = 'D' THEN 'D.전송완료' WHEN SND_STAT_CD = 'E' THEN 'E.전송에러' ELSE SND_STAT_CD END AS SND_STAT_CD
, OUT_GUBUN , SND_STAT_CD
FROM TB_IFS_G1TOEC_OUT )A WHERE 1=1
